Tetsudou Nippon! Rosen Tabi - Joumou Den.name: Tetsudou Nippon! Rosen Tabi: Joumou Denki Tetsudou-hen
Tetsudou Nippon! Rosen Tabi - Joumou Den.summary: A train simulation game from Sonic Powered's "Japanese Rail Sim" series for the Nintendo 3DS, exclusive to Japan. In this entry, you can operate the Joumou Electric Railway's "700" and "Deha 100" train models through a 50.4 km round trip from Chuo Maebashi Station to Nishi Kiryu Station, on Joumou Railway's Joumou Line.
